lang: Hebrew (English summary pp. 156-158 not in the article PDF)
location_note: Two spurs north of Kovovi and Abel Pann Streets, Ramat Denya, Jerusalem; site map ref. NIG 21700-50/62975 (OIG 16700-50/12975). Several features have their own NIG references (winepresses 3I, 1II, 2II, 1III; miqveh complex 1I).
notes: Excavation Areas I-III plus survey sites A-M. Authors' summary: first phase late Second Temple (burial area and miqveh); winepresses (except 1III), cupmarks and cisterns undated but placed after the Second Temple period (Roman at the earliest); second phase Crusader/Mamluk (13th-14th c.) reuse (miqveh turned into a cistern, burial cave 1III turned into a winepress). Agricultural terrace walls not eligible. Channels inside winepresses are part of the winepress rows (choice C4).

features.subtype: rock-cut miqveh 1I with four steps (L30), immersion basin L50, partly built plastered ceiling; converted to a cistern in the Mamluk period
features.period: late Second Temple (architecture; coin of the prefects under Augustus, 6-9 CE, in the fill); reused as cistern in the Mamluk period
features.quote: ארבע מדרגות חצובות (L30) יורדות מפני השטח לקרקעית אגן הטבילה

features.subtype: rock-cut channel draining rainwater from square surface 6I into the miqveh pool
features.period: with the miqveh, late Second Temple
features.quote: התעלה ניקזה את מי הגשמים מהמשטח אל בריכת המקווה

features.subtype: rock-cut channel from cupmark 5I into cistern 2I; overflow channel from the cistern toward the cupmarks 4I
features.period: undated; placed after the Second Temple period
features.quote: תעלה חצובה חיברה בין הבור לבין החציבה העגולה

features.subtype: two rock-cut bell-shaped cisterns (2I, partly cleaned; A, surveyed only) and plastered round cistern L165 inside winepress 1III
features.period: 2I and A undated, placed after the Second Temple period; L165 Crusader/Mamluk with winepress 1III
features.quote: נחשפו שני בורות מים מטיפוס בור-פעמון, החצובים בסלע

features.subtype: rock-cut winepresses 3I, 1II, 2II (treading floors, settling and collecting vats, white mosaic); built winepress 1III in burial cave 1III; cupmarks 4I (three) and 5I
features.period: 3I, 1II, 2II and cupmarks undated, not earlier than the Roman period and later than the Second Temple; 1III Crusader/Mamluk
features.quote: בשטח I נחשפה גת אחת (3I), בשטח II — שתי גתות

features.site: quarries J, K, L and L200
features.subtype: rock surfaces with quarrying lines, quarries up to 1.5 m deep; quarry L200 cut into burial cave 2III
features.quote: באתר נסקרו משטחי סלע ובהם קווי חציבה

features.subtype: kokhim burial caves with shared courtyard, rolling stone in situ (2III), bones under a later floor; 1III later turned into a winepress
features.period: end of the Second Temple period
features.quote: מערות 1III ו-2III, שזמנן שלהי ימי הבית השני

features.subtype: kokhim burial caves, square openings for a blocking stone, filled with alluvium
features.period: end of the Second Temple period (type)
features.quote: במהלך החפירה והסקר נתגלו ארבע מערות קבורה

features.subtype: natural caves near the quarries and winepresses, suggested as stores or seasonal shelters; L130 beside winepress 2II with a cut niche
features.quote: שמונה מערות טבעיות נסקרו, בעיקר באזורי המחצבות והגתות
